### Fixed

- *(codegen)* honor nested nullity annotations on composite types in parameter position
- remove redundant references in format! args for clippy 1.97
- adapt to cargo_toml 1.0 typed version requirements

### Other

- Merge branch 'main' into dependabot/cargo/uuid-1.24.0

## Vector indexes
- [fix] Enabled `TCP_NODELAY` for [auto-embedding](https://github.com/Restream/reindexer/blob/v5.18.1/float_vector.md#embedding-configuration) HTTP connections to reduce latency for requests with small payloads

## Core
- [fea] Reworked the `UPDATE` query engine. The new implementation supports updates with multidimensional arrays and arrays of vectors (for example: `UPDATE ns SET vecs_arr = [[1.0, 1.1], [0.0, 0.7], [[0.5, 0.1], [0.3, 1.0]]]`). It also fixes 24 issues with updates to array elements by position or wildcard, arrays of objects, and uninitialized indexed fields
- [fea] Added explicit sorting to [MERGE queries](https://github.com/Restream/reindexer/blob/v5.18.0/readme.md#merge). `MERGE` now works with
- [fea] Added per-component runtime log level settings to the Database config page

- [fea] Added a progress bar when creating a database dump. See [reindexer tool options](https://github.com/Restream/reindexer/blob/v5.16.0/cpp_src/cmd/reindexer_tool/readme.md#usage) (`--no-progress-meter`)
- [fea] Improved SQL suggest generation via `/db/{database}/suggest` in some cases
- [fea] HTTP endpoint `/db/{database}/suggest` now returns the position in characters, not bytes

## What's Changed
* Openapi support by @jbendotnet in https://github.com/oleksiijko/pmb/pull/68
* fix(mcp): flush buffered perf rows when the server shuts down by @motojojoe in https://github.com/oleksiijko/pmb/pull/69
* fix(mcp): bound the shutdown flush so a signal cannot deadlock the server by @motojojoe in https://github.com/oleksiijko/pmb/pull/70
* fix(engine): match keyed facts with json_extract instead of raw-JSON LIKE by @eeshsaxena in https://github.com/oleksiijko/pmb/pull/71
* Honour --days i
